source_contract.vehicle_selection: all-frame/all-camera YOLO plus SAM2.1, physical-vehicle deduplication, global maximum mask-area observation
source_contract.shadow: official SSISv2 object-shadow association bound to selected vehicle by object-mask IoU
source_contract.geometry: same-frame pure-RGB InfiniDepth depth and visible Gaussian geometry
source_contract.fit: P95 robust bidirectional maximal-camera-cone visible contour
source_contract.aggregation: one-to-five vehicle confidence gate, circular weighted azimuth, and shared-angle joint fit
source_contract.replacement: round 1 uses global ranks 1-3; only a completed no-angle result triggers round 2 with cached detection/ranking and disjoint ranks 4-6

defaults.device: auto: first process-visible CUDA GPU, otherwise CPU
